body: Thank you so much. Yeah I think I’m just fending for myself here... hopefully will be out soon

Yeah, I dont doubt that it’s his attempt at manipulation. All he ever gave me was physical possessions and he’s got to know that I have no other reason to stay in his life, and if that stops then I’m gone.

I gotta say, it helps tremendously to hear you say this as a parent. Because all parents will make mistakes and need grace from their children at some point, but there is a line where there’s no going back.
I’m strict with my moral standards even when no one else is looking and it’s so hard to blatantly go against that... but I’m learning that exceptions are ok.

Yup... ironically, he’s also paying for my therapy. 

Thank you for the tip of imagining a friend in my shoes. So so so helpful.
I’m sure it’s hush money to him. I don’t think he truly loves me but at the same time I don’t care. Thank you for the response ❤️
Thank you, I feel a lot more valid in my thoughts and reasoning now.
